node.title: Budget-three split-pencil normal form
node.statement: Every four-codeword rate-half witness at agreement 3n/4-1 factors into four disjoint omitted-triple locators A_i and six oriented edge factors b_ij satisfying A_k b_ij+A_i b_jk=A_j b_ik. The six incidence types give an exact degree ledger with deg b_ij<=2 and only three possible quadratic slots. The block, edge, singleton, and full locators factor the multiplicative-coset vanishing polynomial and obey an exact pair-locator product identity. This reduces B*=3 to a base-field-normalized split-pencil classification but does not exclude or construct such a pencil.
